title: 13-year-old Corbell hears Knapp's Lazar interview on the radio

tellings.quote: I've said this before, you know, I heard George Knapp's voice interviewing a guy named Bob Lazar on the radio.

plain: In 1990, at 13, the filmmaker Jeremy Corbell heard a radio interview in which a reporter named George Knapp questioned a man named Bob Lazar, who said he had worked on alien craft for the government. Corbell tells Michels he remembers it first-hand: "I heard George Knapp's voice interviewing a guy named Bob Lazar on the radio." He tells it as the moment his own interest in the subject began.
